Industrial Panel & PLC Connectivity
Telecom & Remote Site Uptime Monitoring

values.catalogue:
Industrial Panel & PLC Connectivity — Provides reliable connectivity for industrial panels, PLCs, and control systems to enable remote monitoring and operational visibility.
Telecom & Remote Site Uptime Monitoring — Can be deployed at telecom shelters and unmanned sites for network health monitoring, remote access, and connectivity backup.
IoT Sensor Network Gateway — Acts as a gateway for IoT devices and sensors in smart agriculture, environmental monitoring, and distributed field deployments.
